title: Transcriptome Profiling of HCT-116 Colorectal Cancer Cells with RNA Sequencing Reveals Novel Targets for Polyphenol Nano Curcumin

identity.intervention: Gemini-Cur: curcumin encapsulated in mPEG urethane gemini surfactant nanoparticles.
identity.formulation_details: Main Methods2.1.1–2.1.2 report curcumin and mPEG urethane gemini surfactant from Institute for Color Science and Technology, Tehran; nanoprecipitation using nominal6mg curcumin/100mg surfactant, methanol/PBS and solvent evaporation.
identity_limits: This paper does not report batch particle-size/PDI/zeta-potential, encapsulation efficiency, loading, residual solvent assay or complete carrier structural specification.
The source prints a 0.22 µM syringe-filter unit; apparent reporting typo is not silently treated as a verified dimension.
Formulation method cites earlier work, which was not independently retrieved/read here; no earlier-paper results are imported.
Not chemically or pharmacokinetically interchangeable with free curcumin, turmeric, other nano-curcumin formulations or unspecified polyphenols.
Author sample availability is a research statement, not evidence of current product availability or clinical approval.

model_exposure_controls.model: One human colorectal cancer line, HCT-116. No non-cancer cells, BUB1B-deficient/MVA cells, animals or patients tested in this paper.

exposure.reported: 0–about100µM dose axis; Results3.1 reports24h IC50=51.50. The sentence omits units; the µM unit comes from the figure axis.
exposure.limits: No IC50 confidence interval, per-point sample count, error bars or fitted curve method shown. Gemini carrier molarity/equivalent dose is not defined.
Numeric dose separately tied to this entire time series is not clearly specified; no apoptotic fraction counts.

exposure.reported: 24h drug exposure after seeding;3treated and3untreated RNA samples. Methods2.1.5 describes library preparation from each sample; Figure2 visually showsC1/C2/C3 andT1/T2/T3.
exposure.limits: Exact RNA-seq concentration is not expressly stated; do not silently assign51.50µM. Culture/passages/independent experimental-unit provenance is not described. It is not a reported one-library-per-arm design, but biological independence is unverified.

controls_present: Figure1A includes Gemini carrier alone and unformulated Cur alongside Gemini-Cur, with substantially less viability inhibition by the first two curves.
Untreated HCT-116 controls in RNA-seq, qPCR, Western blot and morphology.
Beta-actin is the stated qPCR/Western normalization control.
controls_missing_or_unclear: No carrier-only/free-curcumin transcriptomic or BUB1B validation arm reported.
No clearly defined matched solvent/PBS vehicle arm or residual-methanol measurement.
Methods mention5-FU positive-control apoptosis images, but Figure1B displays only control plus Gemini-Cur time points; do not credit an observed5-FU arm.
No healthy-cell comparator or checkpoint/fidelity/normal-function endpoint.

RNA_seq.source_location: Supplementary XLSX Sheet2 row77 (ENSG00000156970); concordant rounded values in Discussion p14 and Down label in Table3.
RNA_seq.status: BUB1B result row directly read from native author supplementary XLSX; no raw-count or raw-sequence reanalysis.

qPCR.prose: Methods/Results/Discussion call BUB1B downregulated, with2^-delta-delta-Ct and untreated reference.
qPCR.visual_conflict: Figure6A bars labeled fold change expression put BUB1B at approximately2.1, CDK1/CCNA2 above1 and ATF3 below1, opposite to prose under the stated usual treated/control interpretation. Same conflict in current PMC native image. Ratio inversion is possible but not specified; unresolved.
qPCR.statistics: No error bars, replicate labels, specific BUB1B PCR P value or test description in figure/caption.
qPCR.decision: Do not credit a clean independently concordant qPCR validation.

protein.source_location: Figure6B BUB1B120kDa lane weaker in Gemini-Cur than control; beta-actin bands visibly similar.
protein.limits: Representative two-lane cropped blot; no densitometry, error bars, replicate count, target-antibody catalog number or uncropped blots supplied in main text. Not independently replicated or quantified by reviewer.

bub1b_evidence.causality: No binding/target-engagement test, BUB1B rescue/epistasis, kinetochore localization, checkpoint challenge, mitotic completion or chromosome-segregation-error experiment. Expression changes may accompany altered cell-cycle composition/cytotoxic stress.

material_positives: Gemini-Cur causes greater HCT-116 viability reduction than plotted carrier-alone and free-curcumin comparators; dose-response and apoptotic morphology support a cancer-cell activity claim.

Author-reported3+3 RNA samples/libraries support a treatment-associated transcriptomic response. Native supplementary BUB1B row confirms RNA suppression; global reported DEG counts do not reproduce from the supplied result table.
BUB1B suppression reported by RNA-seq is qualitatively compatible with weaker protein band.
nulls_inconsistencies: GADD45G RNA-seq upregulation was not significantly confirmed by PCR and was not detected by Western according to Discussion. Figure6 labels GADD45A instead of GADD45G.

Table1 prints identical forward and reverse sequences for ATF3 and beta-actin, despite different product lengths; this is a reproducibility/reporting concern, not proof that the actual experiments used those erroneous primers.
Table5 caption says upregulated genes while listing BUB1B among genes the text classifies as downregulated.
Figure6A direction conflict and omitted uncertainty prevent treating all claimed validations as clean concordant results.

Native supplementary result table count check does not reproduce the global DEG counts:3891data rows,820padj<.01,243up/197down at additional absolute log2FC>2; authors report3892/244/198. BUB1B itself meets the reported significance threshold.

functional_scope.measured: Cancer-cell viability and qualitative apoptotic morphology.
functional_scope.distinction: Pathway enrichment terms for checkpoint/spindle/segregation are annotations of gene lists, not measured functional improvements. Prior subG1/Hoechst/cell-cycle claims cited in this paper are not new experiments independently qualified here.

competitive_assessment.disposition: Formulation-specific experimental counterevidence to a BUBR1-restoration nomination; not nominated for MVA.
competitive_assessment.comparison: The paper has an actual compound-formulation treatment and cancer-cell effect, but neither a useful-normal-function result nor BUBR1 restoration. It does not displace provisional niacin restoration or apitegromab muscle compensation. Niacin and apitegromab remain unproven in MVA; no head-to-head superiority or patient-specific harm is inferred.
competitive_assessment.asymmetry_avoided: Cancer-cell BUB1B lowering alone does not prove every exposure or all curcumin formulations harm MVA, just as indirect mechanism evidence does not prove niacin benefits MVA.

integration_recommendation.recommended_action: Add a distinct formulation-specific primary appraisal, if the curated ledger records evaluated non-nominated compounds; also update existing PMID/NIH role notes with direction and contradictions.
integration_recommendation.reason: No existing exact-formulation entry found. Actual intervention plus primary BUB1B RNA/protein direction warrants a distinct evidence record, not an efficacy nomination. A generic polyphenol query must not become a second appraisal.
